newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European Air Cargo Association (EACA) disbands.
newsitem.headline: European Air Cargo Association (EACA) disbands.

text.p: The European Air Cargo Association (EACA) has formally itself disbanded after two years of existence, one of its founders, Peter Schoute told Reuters.
EACA consisted of the Netherlands Air Cargo Carriers Association (ACAN), together with its Belgian and British equivalents.
Schoute added that a major problem was that many other European countries did not have their own cargo associations and it was difficult to persuade them to create such an organisation.
EACA was also unable to persuade the Irish, Swiss, Finnish, Greek or Austrian organisations to become members.
It also felt that it would overlap with work of The International Air Cargo Association(TIACA) and the Forum for Air Cargo in Europe(FACE) backed by the European Air Shippers Council, he added.
Schoute is now a member of the European industry affairs committee of TIACA.
After three years with the Dutch association ACAN, he has also resigned as chairman to enable him to take on the TIACA role.
ACAN's new chairman is Achim van de Graaff of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
